messages:
Leah (CS): @ops-bot created ticket INF-4921 for Manta Logistics private NER onboard. Customer needs private deployment with HSM + PHI compliance. They asked for guidance on evals and latency SLA — can @Miguel and @Ravi help scope?
ops-bot: Ticket INF-4921 created by Leah (CS) — assigned to #customer-success, tag:private-onboard
Miguel (ML Eng): Happy to help. Quick q — are they bringing their own model checkpoint, or requesting us to host one from the catalog? Also, what precision/quantization do they expect?
Leah (CS): They're sending a custom fine-tuned LlamaX-13B checkpoint. They explicitly flagged PHI, want BYOK + HSM + VPC. Also asked for p95 latency <= 200ms for single-request NER. Renewal flags: they said onboarding delays will impact renewal review.
Ravi (Solutions): For PHI + HSM we need Private deploy (customer VPC with private control plane) or on-prem. Recommend Dedicated reserved pool for predictable perf. I'll draft an SOW and cost estimate. Need perf targets, sample data, and retention policy.
Elena (Legal): Re: PHI — we'll need an executed BAA and data processing addendum. BYOK + HSM is preferable. Also confirm whether they want us to retain logs for telemetry or set to zero retention.
Leah (CS): Confirmed BYOK + HSM. They prefer no logs stored except basic metrics. Scheduling: customer available Wed 10am PT for enablement. @Ravi can you lead the call? I'll send the invite.
Ravi (Solutions): Wed 10am PT works. I'll lead. Preparing an intake checklist: dataset upload link (S3 presigned), keywrap instructions, and an eval rubric. Example model config I'll share during call:
```yaml
model_name: manta-13b-ner
deployment: private-vpc
hsm_required: true
p95_latency_ms: 200
batching_policy: conservative
retention: minimal
```
Miguel (ML Eng): After sample upload I'll run: 1) safety scans for PHI leakage and hallucination risk, 2) entity-level precision/recall, 3) perf on sequence lengths 128 and 512. Request: initial sample ~500 labeled examples (2k max for first pass). Target: F1 >= 0.86; if below, propose fine-tune/relabel loop.
Leah (CS): Important timeline note: customer renewal review is on 2026-03-20 and they said onboarding status will influence the renewal decision. Ops risk: need onboarding done by 2026-03-15 to avoid escalation.
Elena (Legal): I'll prepare the BAA draft and data addendum now, share redlines in this thread by EOD tomorrow. Also need to confirm jurisdiction and DSGVO clauses — @Leah please collect customer region info.
Miguel (ML Eng): I'll reserve a canary slot on a Dedicated A100 pool for perf testing once dataset is uploaded. Plan: run latency + throughput profile, KV cache sizing, and a quick quantization compatibility test.
Leah (CS): Action items recap: Ravi — SOW + calendar invite + intake checklist; Miguel — eval plan + perf run; Elena — BAA draft; Leah — customer comms + region info. I'll post the checklist and the invite link here after I send it. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Solutions): I'll also include a short onboarding playbook (upload steps, expected outputs, escalation path). Adding link to our private onboarding doc in the invite.
Leah (CS): Thanks team — I'll update customer and confirm upload window. If anyone needs access to the ticket, ping me and I'll add.
